taskSpec.projectDescription: A fitness logging application that allows users to record workouts, maintain custom exercise lists, view historical workout data in a table format, and analyze their fitness trends through visual charts.
taskSpec.projectGoal: To provide users with an intuitive tool for tracking fitness activities, managing exercises, reviewing workout history, and gaining insights through data visualization.
constraints: Basic data persistence using local storage or simple file-based storage
risks: Data visualization libraries may not be compatible with target platform
Performance issues with large history log tables
Difficulty in maintaining consistent data formats across different chart types
Potential complexity in syncing custom exercise lists with workout records

agentInstructions.architect: Design a simple architecture that supports basic CRUD operations for workouts and exercises, with data storage and visualization components.
agentInstructions.system: Implement basic system components including data models, storage mechanisms, and chart rendering capabilities without complex integrations.
agentInstructions.designer: Create a clean, functional UI layout focusing on workout logging, exercise management, history table, and chart display areas.
agentInstructions.reviewer: Review the application's functionality against the defined MVP scope, ensuring all included features work as expected.
agentInstructions.coder: Develop core application logic for workout recording, exercise list management, history log display, and chart generation using appropriate libraries.
agentInstructions.tester: Conduct functional testing of all core features including workout logging, exercise creation, history table rendering, and chart visualization.
agentInstructions.debugger: Identify and resolve any technical issues related to data handling, UI rendering, or chart generation within the MVP scope.
agentInstructions.security: Implement basic security measures such as input sanitization for exercise names and workout descriptions to prevent injection attacks.

features.description: Allow users to record new workouts with exercise selections and duration details.

features.name: Custom Exercise Management
features.description: Enable users to add, edit, and delete custom exercises for future workout use.

features.description: Display a table of past workouts with date, exercise type, and duration.

maintainability: Codebase organized in modular components for easy updates and modifications
Documentation of data structures and API endpoints for future enhancements

Sufficient color contrast for visual elements in charts and tables
